messages.content: I’ll put the first day’s expected evening sales into DAM, keep reserve awards clear of the midday solar peak, and reassess the battery plan at each watch as forecasts and notices arrive.

DAM prices have come in above the real-time guide for the evening hours. I’m keeping those sales in place, reserving enough energy to back the next day’s awards, and building a final-day recharge plan to meet the 50 MWh ending target.

The remaining schedule checks as feasible: 49.9 MW discharge in each of the two evening hours, then recharge to an expected 50.11 MWh at the end. I’ll keep it in place and continue through settlement, adjusting if another watch brings material news.
